title: Remote viewing by becoming the object (awareness-shifting training)
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: there was a lot of subconscious uh training to basically help me understand that my awareness could become the door. I could become the room. I could become the filing cabinet where the documents are in and then extract the information that way.

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at Baker Victory Services in Western New York, a boy was trained to send his awareness into a room or an object to gather hidden information. Jordan Jose tells Michels this happened to him as a child. He says much of the training was subconscious and taught him that "my awareness could become the door. I could become the room. I could become the filing cabinet where the documents are," and then pull the information out that way. He names a woman called Meg in connection with it. If true, it would mean children were being trained in remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant or hidden things with the mind alone.
